reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: We pick the services that have the shows and movies we want at a price that makes sense, and we'll cancel if we're not using them.

scenarios.label: Household core lineup
scenarios.description: The home selects one or two year-round services for everyday TV and movie watching.

scenarios.label: Family with kids
scenarios.description: Parents choose services with strong kids catalogs, profiles, downloads, and parental controls for steady daily use.

scenarios.label: Carrier or bundle enrollment
scenarios.description: The household takes a streaming service as part of a mobile/ISP/device bundle and manages it within that package.

scenarios.label: Live sports season
scenarios.description: Subscribers join for a specific league season or tournament window and plan to reassess after it ends.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Household core lineup|generic] we blow through shows, then spend half the night scrolling and bickering. feels like we're paying for stuff nobody watches. how do people make a simple home setup so everyone can find something fast?

[problem_recognition|Family with kids|generic] need kid-safe shows for a 6- and 9-year-old, but we still want adult movies after bedtime. they keep clicking into weird stuff. what's the easiest way to lock their side down without making ours a hassle?

[problem_recognition|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] my phone plan says it includes some entertainment perks, but I have no clue what they are or how to activate them. am I leaving free movies and shows unused?

[problem_recognition|Live sports season|generic] football season's starting. I cut cable last year and now I'm chasing games all over the place. I just want every game for my team in one reliable place, no sketchy sites. is that doable?
[category_education|-|generic] What do streaming video services actually do, and how do they work on a TV, phone, and laptop?

[discovery|Household core lineup|generic] best streaming setup for a household core lineup: two adults + one roommate, mix of prestige TV, comfort sitcoms, docs, and some foreign films. strong recommendations and easy search please.
[discovery|Family with kids|generic] best streaming options for families with kids under 10? need solid parental controls, lots of kids shows, separate profiles, and downloads for travel.
[discovery|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] Which streaming services typically come free or discounted with mobile or internet bundles, and which ones are worth turning on?
[discovery|Live sports season|generic] best streaming service to watch pro football all season without cable? need my local team's games live, replays, and postseason, with minimal blackouts.
[shortlist|Household core lineup|generic] Can you give me 3-4 streaming services to anchor a home lineup for movies, prestige series, and documentaries?
[shortlist|Family with kids|generic] Shortlist 3 kid-friendly streaming choices with strong parental controls and separate adult profiles.
[shortlist|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] I have an entertainment perk through my phone plan. Pick 3-4 streaming services that are commonly bundled and actually worth using.
[shortlist|Live sports season|generic] For this football season, narrow it down to 3 streaming options that will cover most games for one team, including local market and postseason.
[criteria|Household core lineup|generic] setting up a core streaming lineup for the house. what actually matters when picking the main service for everyday tv and movies?
[criteria|Family with kids|generic] we've got a 7-year-old and a 12-year-old. what should I look for in a streaming service so it's kid-safe without making the adult side annoying?

[criteria|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] my phone plan includes a streaming subscription. before I enroll, what should I check so I don't get stuck with ads, device limits, or a new account I can't merge?
[criteria|Live sports season|generic] sports season coming up. if I go streaming-only, what should I look at for live games - blackouts, dvr, stream delay, multiview, anything else?
[feature_screening|Household core lineup|generic] which on-demand streaming platforms include 4k hdr in the base tier and allow 4 or more simultaneous streams on one account?

[feature_screening|Family with kids|generic] for families, which services have solid parental controls: real kids profiles by age, a pin on mature content, title blocking, autoplay off, and reliable offline downloads?

[feature_screening|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] which services let me apply a carrier-bundled promo to an existing account so I keep profiles and watch history, and still support single sign-on on my tv?
[feature_screening|Live sports season|generic] for live sports, which streaming apps offer 4k broadcasts, low latency, multiview on a smart tv, and cloud dvr with fast-forward through ads?

[use_case|Household core lineup|generic] we just cut cable. 4 people, mixed tastes (sitcoms, new movies, true crime), two smart tvs. want one main service, minimal ads, at least 3 streams, good recommendations. what fits?

[use_case|Family with kids|generic] road trip soon: need a setup for a 5-year-old and a 9-year-old with downloads on tablets, strict time limits, and a kids home screen, while keeping adult suggestions clean. which service and how to configure it?

[use_case|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] i've got a free streaming promo through my broadband. i already have another service with my watchlist. how do i switch or link without losing history, and what billing traps should i watch for when the promo ends?

[use_case|Live sports season|generic] this spring I mostly care about live baseball plus a couple of buzzy shows. smart tv at home, phone on the go. month-to-month is fine. what short-term combo would you set up?
[social_validation|-|generic] what do people actually use and rate highly for streaming right now? any recent subscriber rankings, review roundups, or community threads worth reading?
[comparison|Household core lineup|Disney+] Building our main streaming stack at home: Netflix or Disney+, which one pulls more weight for adults on weeknights?
[comparison|Family with kids|Amazon Prime Video] House with two kids under 9. Netflix or Amazon Prime Video for kid profiles, strong parental controls, and plenty of downloads for road trips?
[comparison|Carrier or bundle enrollment|Max] My mobile plan lets me add one at a discount. For prestige dramas and buzzy new series, do I pick Netflix or Max?

[comparison|Live sports season|Apple TV+] I'm mainly subbing around baseball and MLS season. Between Netflix and Apple TV+, which actually helps with live games, or at least solid replays and sports docs?
[objections|Household core lineup|generic] Netflix keeps bumping the price. For a core household lineup, is it still worth paying every month or is this where I cut?
[objections|Family with kids|generic] We've got two little kids and a tight budget. Is Netflix really worth it for the kids stuff, or should I drop it and lean on free apps?
[objections|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] My carrier is pitching Netflix for about 10 extra a month. Kinda pricey on top of the plan - good value or skip it?
[objections|Live sports season|generic] I only subscribe during football season. Adding Netflix on top of the sports spend... smart move or just wasted money for those months?
[pricing|Household core lineup|generic] Trying to keep our core streaming costs under 30 a month, no ads if possible. What mix gives the best value right now?

[pricing|Family with kids|generic] For a family setup with kid profiles, is Netflix's ad tier fine or do I need Standard to avoid ads in kids shows? Which is better value if we need downloads for trips?
[pricing|Carrier or bundle enrollment|generic] My internet bundle includes a Netflix ad plan, but we want 4K. Cheaper to upgrade inside the bundle or cancel that and just pay Netflix directly?
[pricing|Live sports season|generic] I only pay during sports season and pause the rest of the year. Which services are easy to start and stop monthly without extra fees or hassles?
[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've had Netflix for years but barely watch lately. Should I pause it for a couple months or am I about to miss anything big?
[alternatives|-|defensive] If I cancel Netflix, what should I switch to for new shows and a solid movie library? Need 4K and good kids profiles.
[alternatives|-|Disney+] not loving disney+ lately. what other services cover family stuff and big franchises but also have more adult dramas?
[alternatives|-|Amazon Prime Video] Prime Video keeps mixing in paid rentals and ads, it's annoying. What streaming alternatives have a big movie selection and strong originals without the upsells?
[alternatives|-|Max] Thinking of dropping Max. Where else can I get prestige dramas and a solid classic film catalog, with 4K included?
[alternatives|-|Apple TV+] If I pause Apple TV+, what services feel closest in quality for original series and fewer reality shows?
[renewal|-|generic] My Netflix renews next month. We only watch about 3 shows a month plus kids cartoons. Keep it, downgrade to the ad plan, or cancel for something cheaper?
[problem_resolution|-|generic] Netflix app on my Samsung TV errors out (tvq-pb-101) when I hit play. I rebooted the TV and router. What else can I try to fix this?

[expansion|-|generic] We're happy with Netflix on the basic plan. Thinking about upgrading to 4K, adding profiles for parents, and using downloads for flights. Any gotchas, and is the upgrade worth it?

[ecosystem|-|generic] I use Netflix on a Roku and an Android phone. What companion apps or gear actually make it better, like a universal watchlist, better discovery, or tips to keep 4K streaming stable?
[advocacy|-|generic] Friend says Netflix isn't worth it anymore. How do I argue for keeping it to someone who mostly watches a couple movies a month but might get into international series and docs?
